sections.title: Brave Frontier Heroes
sections.content: A young boy who works as a blaster in a mine considered a sacred site. This sacred site, protected by his family for generations, is a mine from which ancient relics and valuable metals are extracted. They mined in accordance with traditions, contributing to the advancement of civilization through the study of these relics. The explosives he uses are said to be one of the outcomes of this research. However, the bandit leader, having acquired one of the relics, threatens their sacred site and plots to take over the artifacts being excavated. The peace-loving clan of the sacred site could do nothing but watch.
